text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!!!
Crowned the champion of the spring season is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—To the logic that binds us...
Too bad for you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am not the predetermined radiance
that you desire...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Alongside a one-of-a-kind partner, she made her own choice, broke her shackles, and was reborn right here—what a mad brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And now, I feel it so vividly!
The throbbing pulse of this world being destroyed
and reborn into a brand-new one!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have found it.
My new raison d'être...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—To all of you witnessing this!!!
Right here and now, I have proven my "strength"!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"My running, my brilliance, is eternal!
Rejoice!! For from this day forth,
you shall all continue to bask in intoxication!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...You will keep running, won't you?
...Even from now on—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You gave it everything, Tanino Gimlet!!
And I'm so relieved you didn't get hurt～～!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I can't believe you actually pulled it off without a hitch...!!
Congrats, Gimlet and Trainer!!
You were insanely cool!!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Gimlet! Gim! Lady Gimlet! Tanino Gimlet!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible sight...
Everyone's looking at Gim-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So this is what it means to hold true to your resolve...! Senpai's... destruction...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let anyone say I 'can't'...
I'll shut them all up with my running...!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Can I really do the same thing...!?
What is it that I 'can't do'...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――...Look at that, it is here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The old me would've definitely decided for myself that 'I can't do it'—but now...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...It's over. Our proof.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Tanino Gimlet gave it one more shot
with me, I am able to stand by her side
as her Trainer today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This moment... is the world she destroyed and rebuilt for me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
I merely stayed true to my own aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――Gim-senpai!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka suddenly appeared.
That scene was reminiscent of
after last year's Japanese Derby, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I came here because
there's something I need to tell you, Gim-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Her expression carried a 'fierce' determination, completely different from last year...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Watching your Yasuda Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen, Senpai,
it really hit me once again."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I... I wanted to become an Umamusume
who can smash through common sense, adversity, everything,
just like Gimlet-senpai...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"To make that happen, though,
I have to challenge conventional wisdom and all that
without being afraid...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then...! The thing that's the ultimate given for me—
The thing I think is the most 'impossible' for me—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "I'm making it my goal to surpass Gimlet-senpai!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't know when it'll be, and it might be super far off...! But without fail—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I will run with you, Senpai!!
And then, I want to surpass you—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No, I'll surpass it!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haha... Hahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahahaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, Vodka!
One day, I will definitely face you!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: But before that—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby.
Show me that you can conquer it."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: This is a "vow"—between you and me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...!! Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely become a Derby Umamusume!
And—one day, I'll run alongside you, Senpai!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
—Thank you so much for your hard work today!
Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Fufu...—
choice_data_list: A new future has been born.
A new future has been born, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...It was just as you said.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "Achieve an even greater feat than the MC Rotation," right?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ......I have indeed fulfilled it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the day after the Takarazuka Kinen, it was time to decide our path forward—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It's myth itself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: From here on, what we strive for and portray is the creation of a new world through destruction and rebirth...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other words!
The advent of Tanino Gimlet, the "God of Destruction"!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...After finishing the 'MC Rotation,'
my senses drifted further away from 'destiny.'
However, having gone through the Yasuda-Takarazuka rotation—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have attained a new sensation――
namely, the pulse of world creation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
By me sprinting through the present, by running alongside me!
The world, the mighty, their future—
shall all be steadily destroyed and reborn!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Into something more dazzling, more chaotic, unimaginable to anyone, brimming with potential—a beautiful, beloved chaos...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet's words sounded grand, but I too had an idea of the destruction and rebirth she spoke of—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The future as a Trainer that Tanino Gimlet gave me through running both the Yasuda Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A new future, dwelling within Vodka's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the future built atop the common sense, ideologies, and preconceived notions
that Tanino Gimlet shattered by running...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I aim for it. The stage where the beloved strong gather.
To descend as the "God of Destruction"—
and bestow a new chaos upon it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as Tanino Gimlet said, by standing at the pinnacle of this era, she will surely influence more people than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Eventually, that will lead to a massive change,
turning into a frenzy powerful enough
to revolutionize the entire racing world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is truly a kind of—creation of a new world...!
choice_data_list: —Then next up is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
—Then next up is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just like the Takarazuka Kinen, we'll aim for a race
where era-defining figures like Symboli Kris S gather."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Except this time, as the "God of Destruction"—
to prove I stand at the pinnacle of this era!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Hear one word and understand ten, do you...?
Man, you really are something...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us begin...!
Our magnificent creation myth!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond "strength,"
to descend as the "God of Destruction"—
the promised land is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!
